name: agent-dispatch-codex
description: Codex-native cost-aware task routing across Sol, Terra, and Luna custom agents, with automatic hooks and serial primary-agent Git.

interface.shortDescription: Route planning, search, development, hard work, and review to cost-aware agents.
interface.longDescription: Automatically injects Codex-native routing guidance and generates project-local custom agents after installation. Keeps trivial work in the primary agent, routes bounded search and development to Luna, broad read-heavy mapping and difficult execution to Terra, and reserves Sol for non-trivial planning or high-risk review. Keeps pure Git CLI operations serial in the primary agent, limits concurrent subagents, and tells the coordinator to close agents as soon as their work is integrated.
defaultPrompt: Show the effective Agent Dispatch policy for this project.

Explain the automatic Sol, Terra, and Luna task routing.
